title: Easy Rice Bake
ingredients: 6 oz dry angel hair or spaghetti, broken into pieces
2 (or more to taste) tablespoons chicken soup base
instructions: Sauté butter, diced onion, broken pasta, and rice until browned.
Move to a 9x13 glass dish and spread evenly.
Boil 4.5 cups of water with chicken soup base, salt, and pepper.
notes: Can add veggies or meat to make it more of a full meal. Makes a large batch. Recipe credit: happyhealthyhome on IG.
